observed_failure.cause: Raw market/series tickers were interpolated into URL path segments without percent-encoding; spaces/control characters therefore failed URL validation before an HTTP response existed.

transport_changes.path_segment_encoding: urllib.parse.quote(value, safe='') for market_ticker and series_ticker path segments
transport_changes.serial_recovery_scope: Only requests whose initial or preceding result is API_UNRESOLVED
transport_changes.serial_exception_policy: Any residual exception is converted to API_UNRESOLVED diagnostic so the frozen zero-unresolved gate, not process abortion, decides materialization.
transport_changes.route_resolution: unchanged historical-first; live only after historical 404

governance: This repair changes URL serialization only. Raw ticker identity remains unchanged in outputs and counting. No semantic, temporal, inclusion, horizon, staleness, denominator or N rule may change in response to the failed transport attempt.
